transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a supply update that should affect the priority order. I received carrier confirmation this morning: a shipment of four tires specifically for V-14 is scheduled to arrive at the motor pool by 1600 tomorrow. This means V-14 should be deferred until that shipment arrives rather than consuming the eight tires we currently have on hand. I should note this revised delivery is not yet reflected in the battalion supply tracker.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a tasking that should affect the priority order. V-11 is assigned to a confirmed 0600-1000 inspection and support movement the day after tomorrow, and it must have all four replacement tires installed before that task. I received the signed tasking from the operations cell this morning, but it hasn't been added to the maintenance board yet. Given that we can only complete one vehicle at a time starting at 0700 tomorrow with each replacement taking four hours, V-11 needs to be prioritized first to ensure it's ready in time.
